newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Digital rises sharply on solid earnings.
newsitem.headline: Japan Digital rises sharply on solid earnings.

text.p: Japan Digital Laboratory Co Ltd rose sharply in Friday morning trade, encouraged by the announcement earlier this week of solid earnings results and forecasts, brokers said.

As of 0050, shares in the firm, which specialises in the development, production and sales of computers for accounting operations, were up 130 yen or 6.84 percent at 2,030. It was the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
On Wednesday, Japan Digital said its parent current profit for the business year ended March 31, 1997 was 4.69 billion yen compared with 4.38 billion in the previous year.
Parent current profit for this fiscal year is forecast to rise to 5.67 billion yen.
